camel_example: aliyun ossutil api get-meta-query-status --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Retrieves the metadata index information of a specified bucket
description_zh: 获取指定存储空间（Bucket）的元数据索引库信息
name: GetMetaQueryStatus

schema.description_en: The response to the request for retrieving metadata index information
schema.description_zh: 获取元数据索引信息的响应

MetaQueryStatus.description_en: The container that stores the metadata index information
MetaQueryStatus.description_zh: 保存元数据索引信息的容器

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the metadata index was created. The time follows the RFC 3339 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+TIMEZONE format. YYYY-MM-DD indicates the date. T indicates the beginning of the time element. HH:mm:ss indicates the hour, minute, and second. TIMEZONE indicates the time zone
CreateTime.description_zh: 元数据索引库的创建时间，遵循RFC 3339标准格式，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+TIMEZONE。其中YYYY-MM-DD表示年月日，T表示time元素的开头，HH:mm:ss表示时分秒，TIMEZONE表示时区

Phase.description_en:
The current scan type. Valid values:

FullScanning: Full scanning is in progress.
IncrementalScanning: Incremental scanning is in progress
Phase.description_zh:
当前扫描类型。取值范围如下：

FullScanning：全量扫描中

IncrementalScanning：增量扫描中

State.description_en:
The status of the metadata index. Valid values:

Ready: The metadata index is being prepared after creation. You cannot query data by using the metadata index.
Stop: Suspended.
Running: Running.
Retrying: Retrying after a creation failure.
Failed: Creation failed.
Deleted: Deleted
State.description_zh:
元数据索引库的状态。取值范围如下：

Ready：创建后准备中

元数据索引库正在准备中，您无法通过元数据索引库查询到数据。

Stop：已暂停

Running：运行中

Retrying：创建失败后重试中

Failed：创建失败

Deleted：已删除

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the metadata index was created. The time follows the RFC 3339 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+TIMEZONE format. YYYY-MM-DD indicates the date. T indicates the beginning of the time element. HH:mm:ss indicates the hour, minute, and second. TIMEZONE indicates the time zone
UpdateTime.description_zh: 元数据索引库的创建时间，遵循RFC 3339标准格式，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss+TIMEZONE。其中YYYY-MM-DD表示年月日，T表示time元素的开头，HH:mm:ss表示时分秒，TIMEZONE表示时区
